data.title: Energy Vault Announces Strategic Agreement to Deploy 1.25 GW of Integrated Power Infrastructure for Hyperscaler AI Data Center with Leading Power Generation EPC Deploying Caterpillar Gensets
data.description: In Westlake Village, California, Energy Vault Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: NRGV) recently disclosed a significant development. The company, known as a top player in sustainable energy infrastructure, revealed the signing of a key commercial deal. According to this agreement, Energy Vault will be providing battery energy storage systems (BESS), grid-forming power conversion systems, and AI infrastructure control software. This support is intended for an initial rollout that encompasses a substantial 1.25 gigawatts (GW) of integrated power infrastructure catering to hyperscaler AI data needs.

data.title: Table Trac, Inc. Announces Quarterly Dividend
data.description: On August 7, 2026, Table Trac Inc. (OTCQX: TBTC) based in Minnetonka, announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.02 per share for its common stock. Shareholders of record as of August 28, 2026, will receive the dividend on September 11, 2026.

data.title: FAA Orders Inspection Of Boeing Jets. Wall Street Eyes Break From Resistance Level.
data.description: Investors are paying close attention to Boeing's production ramp-up efforts after years of strict government caps. Boeing stock rose by 8% this week following a crucial regulatory approval. The FAA has ordered inspections of Boeing jets. Wall Street is optimistic about a potential break from resistance levels.

data.title: Clarity Act Hopes Dive As Senate Delays Vote Until After Summer Recess
data.description: Before the August recess, the Senate decided to postpone voting on the Clarity Act, pushing it back to September. The chances of the Act passing in 2026 are diminishing. This delay in the Senate's vote on the Clarity Act has led to a decrease in hopes for its approval.

data.title: Whole Foods Market and National Young Farmers Coalition Launch Next Generation Farmer Fund to Support the Future of American Agriculture
data.description: A new initiative has been started by Whole Foods Market and the National Young Farmers Coalition in Austin, Texas. The Next Generation Farmer Fund has been established to provide support for the future of American agriculture. This collaboration aims to assist young farmers financially, with an initial investment of XX million dollars. The fund will focus on fostering the growth of the next generation of farmers and promoting sustainable agricultural practices. This partnership highlights the commitment of both organizations to the development and success of upcoming farmers in the United States.

data.description: A company based in Mt. Prospect, Illinois, Unitel Technologies, has recently revealed a successful showcase of its Merlin process highlighting the production of methanol using captured carbon dioxide.
